# LonelyConnections — the Lonely Runner under other names (cited)

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** planned: cited from a paper · **Diagram:** [The Lonely Runner: pile-ups, shifts and residue sieves](../../GRAPH.md#the-lonely-runner-pile-ups-shifts-and-residue-sieves)

Equivalent forms: Wills' Diophantine approximation (the gap of loneliness; Kronecker's theorem makes the real and whole-number versions equivalent), Cusick's view-obstruction problem and billiard trajectories, the covering radius of lattice zonotopes (Henze and Malikiosis 2017), and the Lonely Runner polyhedra of Beck, Hoşten and Schymura. One-way: the conjecture implies a statement about nowhere-zero flows in graphs (Bienia, Goddyn, Gvozdjak, Sebő and Tarsi 1998), and colouring bounds for distance graphs; coprime mappings (Newman's conjecture, proved by Pomerance and Selfridge; Bohman and Peng) give the conjecture for speed sets with small values. Warning: the shifted version, with different starting points, is false from five moving runners on (Blanco, Criado and Santos 2026). All cited, none proved here; the real-time equivalence is the one the Lonely Runner nodes rely on implicitly.

## Published sources

Published work this node rests on or relates to; each entry says how.

- [G. Perarnau and O. Serra, The Lonely Runner Conjecture turns 60, arXiv 2409.20160 (survey)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.20160) — Section 3 (connections) and Section 10 (variants): the statements cited here
- [T. W. Cusick, View-obstruction problems, Aequationes Math. 9 (1973) 165-170](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01832623) — the view-obstruction form
- [M. Henze and R. D. Malikiosis, On the covering radius of lattice zonotopes and its relation to view-obstructions and the lonely runner conjecture, Aequationes Math. 91 (2017) 331-352, arXiv 1609.01939](https://arxiv.org/abs/1609.01939) — the zonotope covering-radius form
- [M. Beck, S. Hoşten and M. Schymura, Lonely Runner polyhedra, Integers 19 (2019) A29, arXiv 1606.01783](https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.01783) — the polyhedral criterion
- [W. Bienia, L. Goddyn, P. Gvozdjak, A. Sebő and M. Tarsi, Flows, view obstructions, and the lonely runner, J. Combin. Theory Ser. B 72 (1998) 1-9](https://doi.org/10.1006/jctb.1997.1770) — the flows implication and the runner formulation
- [M. Blanco, F. Criado and F. Santos, Coloopless and cosimple zonotopes, and the Lonely Runner Conjectures, arXiv 2603.24784](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24784) — counterexamples to the shifted version from five moving runners
